extracted.intended_audience: journalists and reporters (especially data journalists and investigative reporters) working on verification, disinformation, and media manipulation
extracted.subtask_description: Practical handbook-style guidance for journalists on investigating and verifying disinformation and media manipulation across platforms (social accounts, messaging apps, images, ads, networks, deepfakes). Includes methods, case studies, and platform-specific techniques.

rubrics_metrics.name: Investigating Disinformation and Media Manipulation
rubrics_metrics.description: Overview orientation chapter introducing the handbook's purpose: equipping journalists to investigate disinformation and media manipulation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Frames the handbook as a practical resource; orients readers to the range of topics covered (accounts, bots, messaging apps, information operations, deepfakes).

rubrics_metrics.name: The Age of Information Disorder
rubrics_metrics.description: Explains the contemporary information environment and how it is chaotic and easier to manipulate than ever.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides context for why verification is necessary; likely includes concepts to classify types of information disorder (background/heuristics rather than operational steps).

rubrics_metrics.name: The Lifecycle of Media Manipulation
rubrics_metrics.description: Describes stages in how manipulation campaigns are created, propagated, and sustained.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Useful for understanding where and when to intervene or investigate; informs monitoring and attribution strategies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Investigating Social Media Accounts
rubrics_metrics.description: Practical techniques for investigating individual social media accounts to determine authenticity, origin and intent.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers steps and signals to examine (profile metadata, posting history, network ties); accompanied by case studies showing coordinated efforts and detection methods.

rubrics_metrics.name: Finding patient zero
rubrics_metrics.description: Methods to identify the original source or earliest spreader of a piece of content or narrative.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Techniques to trace back timelines, repost chains and earliest instances across platforms to locate origin points.

rubrics_metrics.name: Spotting bots, cyborgs and inauthentic activity
rubrics_metrics.description: Criteria and indicators for identifying automated accounts (bots), hybrid human-automation accounts (cyborgs), and other inauthentic behavior.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes behavioral signals, metadata patterns and examples; accompanied by a case study (e.g., automated Twitter activity during Hong Kong protests).

rubrics_metrics.name: Monitoring for fakes and information operations during breaking news
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures and priorities for verification under time pressure during breaking events when fakes and coordinated operations spike.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Focus on rapid checks, triage, and preventing amplification of false information; practical workflows for newsroom response during crises.

rubrics_metrics.name: Verifying and questioning images
rubrics_metrics.description: Techniques to verify photographic and video content: provenance, metadata, contextual evidence and signs of manipulation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Tools and heuristics to check geolocation, reverse image search, shadows/lighting, and inconsistencies; guidance on when to publish with caveats.

rubrics_metrics.name: How to think about deepfakes and emerging manipulation technologies
rubrics_metrics.description: Assessment of deepfake technologies and other emerging manipulation tools, and how journalists should approach and evaluate them.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers threat models, detection challenges, and evolving best practices for verification and reporting on synthetic media.

rubrics_metrics.name: Monitoring and Reporting Inside Closed Groups and Messaging Apps
rubrics_metrics.description: Approaches for monitoring, entering, or otherwise reporting on content within private groups and encrypted or closed messaging platforms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Addresses ethical and legal considerations, methods for documenting content, and case studies (e.g., Bolsonaro at the Hospital).

rubrics_metrics.name: Investigating websites
rubrics_metrics.description: Techniques to analyze and verify websites (ownership, hosting, content provenance, mirror sites, and takedown history).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes domain WHOIS checks, hosting and SSL information, archived copies, and signs of coordinated site networks.

rubrics_metrics.name: Analyzing ads on social networks
rubrics_metrics.description: Methods to inspect, contextualize and verify political and other targeted ads on social platforms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers ad library tools, targeting information, funding/sponsorship signals and how ads fit into broader information operations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tracking actors across platforms
rubrics_metrics.description: Strategies for following and correlating actors' activity across multiple social platforms and media.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Techniques include cross-platform profile linking, timeline correlation, content reuse detection and building behavioural dossiers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Network analysis and attribution
rubrics_metrics.description: Using network-analysis methods to map relationships between accounts, pages, sites and to support attribution of campaigns.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers analytic approaches, indicators used for attribution, and case-study applications (e.g., 'Attributing Endless Mayfly', West Papua operation).

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of case studies to illustrate methods
rubrics_metrics.description: The handbook integrates real-world case studies (e.g., coordinated Facebook propaganda in the Philippines; fake Black Lives Matter page; Hong Kong automation; Bolsonaro hospital; West Papua operation) to demonstrate techniques.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Case studies serve as worked examples showing how methods are applied, pitfalls encountered, and attribution arguments constructed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Practical toolkit orientation (tools, checklists and workflows)
rubrics_metrics.description: The handbook is presented as a practical resource that equips journalists with concrete tools and techniques for verification tasks.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasises hands-on steps, checklists and platform-specific tools rather than purely theoretical discussion.
